title: Self-Pay Accounts Awaiting Billing — Care Already Given in Medical Hardship Documentation
content:
### Clause

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), care already given on an awaiting self-pay account that carries no estimate is added to the qualifying medical debt Riverbend documents for its own charges, in one of three ways:
- when it is coded emergency or medically necessary, the program's amounts-generally-billed percentage (34.6 percent on every tier) of its unbilled charges, rounded half-up to the cent, is added;
- when it is coded elective, its unbilled charges less its account type's elective uninsured discount percent (the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) schedule's uninsured discount percent for an elective self-pay account of that account type) of them, that discount being rounded half-up to the cent, are added;
- otherwise nothing is added for awaiting self-pay care.

### Terms

The awaiting self-pay account is the account listed first among the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) accounts in pending billing status with financial class self-pay; when an estimate is linked to it, nothing is added under this rule. Its unbilled charges are the charges posted on it less its self-pay final-bill liabilities.

### Worked cases (hypothetical, no estimate linked)

| Coding | Unbilled charges | Added |
|---|---|---|
| emergency | 2,000.00 | 34.6 percent of 2,000.00: 692.00 |
| elective, account type's elective discount taken as 20 percent | 2,000.00 | 2,000.00 less 400.00: 1,600.00 |
